title: Google\Cloud\Compute\V1\RouterStatusNatStatus
name: RouterStatusNatStatus
description: Status of a NAT contained in this router.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.auto_allocated_nat_ips
params.description: A list of IPs auto-allocated for NAT. Example: ["1.1.1.1", "129.2.16.89"]

params.name: data.drain_auto_allocated_nat_ips
params.description: A list of IPs auto-allocated for NAT that are in drain mode. Example: ["1.1.1.1", "179.12.26.133"].

params.name: data.drain_user_allocated_nat_ips
params.description: A list of IPs user-allocated for NAT that are in drain mode. Example: ["1.1.1.1", "179.12.26.133"].

params.name: data.min_extra_nat_ips_needed
params.description: The number of extra IPs to allocate. This will be greater than 0 only if user-specified IPs are NOT enough to allow all configured VMs to use NAT. This value is meaningful only when auto-allocation of NAT IPs is not used.

params.name: data.num_vm_endpoints_with_nat_mappings
params.description: Number of VM endpoints (i.e., Nics) that can use NAT.

params.name: data.user_allocated_nat_ip_resources
params.description: A list of fully qualified URLs of reserved IP address resources.

params.name: data.user_allocated_nat_ips
params.description: A list of IPs user-allocated for NAT. They will be raw IP strings like "179.12.26.133".
